sqlMap.select: SELECT CPNY_ID, get_global_name(CPNY_NO, 'zh') COMPANY_NAME FROM HR_COMPANY WHERE CPNY_ID LIKE 'C%' AND ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY CPNY_ID
SELECT PA_MONTH PA_MONTH_ID, PA_MONTH FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT(PA_MONTH) PA_MONTH FROM PA_SUMMARY_$CPNY_ID$ ) TT ORDER BY PA_MONTH

select * from (select pai.param_item_id ITEM_ID, pai.alias_name ITEM_NAME, 'paInput' PA_TYPE, 4 ORDERNUM from (SELECT T.PARAM_NO, T.DISTINCT_FIELD, T.DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND, T.PARAM_ITEM_NO, T.DEFAULT_VAL, PI.PARAM_ITEM_ID, SY3.CONTENT ALIAS_NAME, T.CPNY_ID, SY1.CONTENT DISTINCT_FIELD_NAME, SY2.CONTENT DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND_NAME, SY0.CONTENT CPNY_NAME FROM PA_PARAM_ITEM_PARAM T, PA_PARAM_ITEM PI, HR_COMPANY HR, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3, PA_DISTINCT_LIST PA1, PA_DISTINCT_LIST PA2 WHERE T.PARAM_ITEM_NO = PI.PARAM_ITEM_NO AND T.CPNY_ID = HR.CPNY_ID AND HR.CPNY_NO = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.DISTINCT_FIELD = PA1.DISTINCT_FIELD(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = PA1.CPNY_ID(+) AND PA1.ID = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE = 'zh' AND T.DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND = PA2.DISTINCT_FIELD(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = PA2.CPNY_ID(+) AND PA2.ID = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.PARAM_ITEM_NO = SY3.NO(+) AND SY3.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND t.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) pai) tt order by tt.ORDERNUM,ITEM_NAME

select * from (select cal.ITEM_ID, cal.alias_name ITEM_NAME, 'paCal' PA_TYPE, 5 ORDERNUM from (SELECT T.PARAM_NO, T.ITEM_NO, PI.ITEM_ID, SY.CONTENT ALIAS_NAME, T.BONUS_RELEVANCE_FLAG, T.CALCU_ORDER, T.PRICISION, T.CARRY_BIT, T.CPNY_ID, SY0.CONTENT CPNY_NAME, T.APPLY_TYPE, SY1.CONTENT APPLY_TYPE_NAME FROM PA_ITEM_PARAM T, PA_ITEM PI, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY, HR_COMPANY HR, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE T.ITEM_NO = PI.ITEM_NO AND T.ITEM_NO = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.CPNY_ID = HR.CPNY_ID AND HR.CPNY_NO = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE = 'zh' AND T.APPLY_TYPE = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' and t.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) cal union all select pai.param_item_id ITEM_ID, pai.alias_name ITEM_NAME, 'paInput' PA_TYPE, 4 ORDERNUM from (SELECT T.PARAM_NO, T.DISTINCT_FIELD, T.DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND, T.PARAM_ITEM_NO, T.DEFAULT_VAL, PI.PARAM_ITEM_ID, SY3.CONTENT ALIAS_NAME, T.CPNY_ID, SY1.CONTENT DISTINCT_FIELD_NAME, SY2.CONTENT DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND_NAME, SY0.CONTENT CPNY_NAME FROM PA_PARAM_ITEM_PARAM T, PA_PARAM_ITEM PI, HR_COMPANY HR, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3, PA_DISTINCT_LIST PA1, PA_DISTINCT_LIST PA2 WHERE T.PARAM_ITEM_NO = PI.PARAM_ITEM_NO AND T.CPNY_ID = HR.CPNY_ID AND HR.CPNY_NO = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.DISTINCT_FIELD = PA1.DISTINCT_FIELD(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = PA1.CPNY_ID(+) AND PA1.ID = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE = 'zh' AND T.DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND = PA2.DISTINCT_FIELD(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = PA2.CPNY_ID(+) AND PA2.ID = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.PARAM_ITEM_NO = SY3.NO(+) AND SY3.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' and t.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) pai union all select bas.ITEM_ID, bas.ALIAS_NAME ITEM_NAME, 'paBasic' PA_TYPE, 3 ORDERNUM from (SELECT T.PARAM_NO, T.ITEM_NO, T.CPNY_ID, SY0.CONTENT AS CPNY_NAME, T.DISTINCT_FIELD, T.DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND, SY1.CONTENT AS DISTINCT_FIELD_NAME, SY2.CONTENT AS DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND_NAME, T.DEFAULT_VAL, SY3.CONTENT AS ALIAS_NAME, PBI.ITEM_ID FROM PA_BASIC_ITEM_PARAM T, PA_BASIC_ITEM PBI, HR_COMPANY H, PA_DISTINCT_LIST PA1, PA_DISTINCT_LIST PA2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3 WHERE T.ITEM_NO = PBI.ITEM_NO AND T.CPNY_ID = H.CPNY_ID AND H.CPNY_NO = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.DISTINCT_FIELD = PA1.DISTINCT_FIELD(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = PA1.CPNY_ID(+) AND PA1.ID = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND = PA2.DISTINCT_FIELD(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = PA2.CPNY_ID(+) AND PA2.ID = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.ITEM_NO = SY3.NO(+) AND SY3.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' and t.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) bas union all select ini.param_id ITEM_ID, ini.alias_name ITEM_NAME, 'insInput' PA_TYPE, 1 ORDERNUM from (SELECT T.PARAM_NO, T.PARAM_ITEM_NO, SY0.CONTENT AS CPNY_NAME, T.DISTINCT_FIELD, T.DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND, SY1.CONTENT DISTINCT_FIELD_NAME, SY2.CONTENT DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND_NAME, T.DEFAULT_VAL, SY3.CONTENT ALIAS_NAME, IPI.PARAM_ID, T.CPNY_ID FROM IS_PARAM_ITEM_PARAM T, IS_PARAM_ITEM IPI, HR_COMPANY HR, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3, PA_DISTINCT_LIST PA1, PA_DISTINCT_LIST PA2 WHERE T.PARAM_ITEM_NO = IPI.PARAM_ITEM_NO AND T.CPNY_ID = HR.CPNY_ID AND HR.CPNY_NO = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.DISTINCT_FIELD = PA1.DISTINCT_FIELD(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = PA1.CPNY_ID(+) AND PA1.ID = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.DISTINCT_FIELD_2ND = PA2.DISTINCT_FIELD(+) AND T.CPNY_ID = PA2.CPNY_ID(+) AND PA2.ID = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T.PARAM_ITEM_NO = SY3.NO(+) AND SY3.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' and t.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) ini union all select inc.ITEM_ID, inc.alias_name ITEM_NAME, 'insCal' PA_TYPE, 2 ORDERNUM from (SELECT T.PARAM_NO, T.ITEM_NO, T.CPNY_ID, SY0.CONTENT CPNY_NAME, SY1.CONTENT ALIAS_NAME, T.PA_RELEVANCE_FLAG, T.CALCU_ORDER, T.PRICISION, T.CARRY_BIT, II.ITEM_ID FROM IS_ITEM_PARAM T, IS_ITEM II, HR_COMPANY HR, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE T.CPNY_ID = HR.CPNY_ID AND HR.CPNY_NO = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE = 'zh' AND T.ITEM_NO = II.ITEM_NO AND T.ITEM_NO = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE = 'zh' and t.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) inc) tt order by tt.ORDERNUM,ITEM_NAME

SELECT PF.FORMULAR_NO || '' ITEM_ID, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PF.ITEM_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) ITEM_NAME, 'paFormular' PA_TYPE, '1' ORDERNUM FROM PA_ITEM_PARAM PIP, PA_FORMULAR PF WHERE PIP.ITEM_NO = PF.ITEM_NO AND PIP.CPNY_ID = PF.CPNY_ID AND PIP.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND PF.CONDITION LIKE '%EMPID%' ORDER BY ORDERNUM,ITEM_NAME

SELECT D.DEPTID, D.DEPTNO, D.PARENT_DEPT_NO, TO_CHAR(D.DATE_CREATED, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS DATE_CREATED, (SELECT HD2.CONTENT FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D2, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD2 WHERE D2.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO AND D2.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND HD2.DEPTNO(+) = D2.DEPTNO AND HD2.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AS PARENT_DEPT_NAME, HD.CONTENT AS DEPTNAME, D.DEPT_LEVEL, (CASE WHEN D.DEPT_LEVEL > 2 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS ISEXPAND, (CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE PARENT_DEPT_NO = D.DEPTNO) > 0 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END) AS ISPARENT FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE HD.DEPTNO(+) = D.DEPTNO AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND D.DEPTNO IN (SELECT DEPT.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT DEPT, HR_DEPARTMENT HD2, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE DEPT.PARENT_DEPT_NO = HD2.DEPTNO(+) AND DEPT.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO(+) AND HDN.LANGUAGE(+) =#interLanguage:VARCHAR# START WITH DEPT.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
DEPT.DEPT_LEVEL = 1
DEPT.DEPTNO =#DEPT_NO:VARCHAR#
CONNECT BY PRIOR DEPT.DEPTNO = DEPT.PARENT_DEPT_NO)

SELECT S1.MONTHDAY FROM (select imonth || '月' || iday || '日' AS MONTHDAY, DDATE_STR,DDATE, CPNY_ID FROM ar_calender) S1, (select start_day, end_day, begin_month_offset, end_month_offset from ar_statistic_date where stat_no = #STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) S2 WHERE S1.DDATE BETWEEN GET_AR_START_DATE_1(#paYear:VARCHAR#||#paMonth:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, #STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) AND GET_AR_END_DATE_1(#paYear:VARCHAR#||#paMonth:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, #STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) AND S1.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
select a.item_no, a.short_name from ar_item a where a.item_no in (141441, 141442, 141443)

select STAT_NO,get_global_name(STAT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) as STAT_NAME from AR_STATISTIC_DATE_PARAM where 1=1
CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY STAT_NO
